newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Transport Minister queries Santos port fees.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Transport Minister queries Santos port fees.

text.p: Brazilian Transport Minister Alcides Saldanha asked shipowners at the key port of Santos to explain within 15 days how they calculate the rates charged for use of port services, said port authority Codesp.

Codesp has sent a letter to the anti-trust commission CADE denouncing the shipowners' practice of charging exporter and importers a flat rate of $215 per container handled, saying that in many cases their costs were far lower.
"We conducted a study with 157 vessels and found that in 80 percent of the cases their costs were lower," said a spokesman for Codesp, adding that these costs were as low as $40 in some instances.

Saldanha said port operators would also have to explain why they stopped setting and collecting fees for services to importers and exporters, thereby allowing ship-owners to introduce the new flat rate, a statement by Codesp said.
The minister announced the measures after a meeting with Codesp President Marcelo de Azeredo and Port Management Director Frederico Bussinger in Brasilia on Wednesday.
